reviews.title: A Game-Changer for PS5 Storage
reviews.comment: This SSD has been a game-changer for my PS5 storage. If you’re tired of constantly managing your game library due to limited space, this SSD is a must-have upgrade. The performance of this SSD is nothing short of spectacular. With sequential read speeds of up to 7,100MB/sec and write speeds up to 6,800MB/sec, the difference is immediately noticeable. Load times have been drastically reduced, and everything runs smoother and faster. Whether I’m jumping into a demanding AAA title or switching between games, the SSD keeps up effortlessly. What sets this SSD apart is that it's optimized specifically for the PS5. Installation was incredibly straightforward—just pop off the PS5 cover, slot the SSD in, and you're good to go. Also with 2TB of storage, I finally have the freedom to keep all my favorite games installed at once, with plenty of room for future releases. No more shuffling games in and out or worrying about space every time there’s a new update or DLC. This SSD has taken my gaming experience to the next level by eliminating those annoying storage constraints.

reviews.author: stuart davies

reviews.title: So far so good! (PS5 upgrade)
reviews.comment:
Ordered it at 11pm last night and got it at 6am today. God I love living right by the Amazon warehouse lol.
Anyways, install was super easy, speeds were 6400 which is excellent. To all the people complaining when it's not 7100, stop. That's a theoretical maximum that is tested on computers that are setup to get the fastest drive speeds possible. The PS5 is a different machine and has different speeds ok. Unless you spend twice the price for that Barracuda drive, you aren't Gona get above 7000 ok. For $150, this 2TB drive with heat sink is an excellent value. Also, that TINY difference in speed is only going to make a 10 minute drive-to-drive game transfer take 9.5 minutes instead lol. So you're complaining about nothing. Game speeds will be absolutely unaffected, I promise.
Aaaaaanyways, rants aside, this is a good drive. Corsair has been one of my go-to brands for a decade now. Power supplies, keyboards and mice, memory, etc. If I didn't get this I woulda got the Samsung 980 Pro cause I have a few of those too. But this was cheaper and I know Corsair storage is solid. (No pun intended).
Most importantly, this drive wit heat sink is sexy looking too. Not that I'll ever see it, but I'll know it's sitting in my PS5, talking to the ladies (or gentlemen!), livin the high life.
Oh and how did that last screenshot get in there? What the heck? It's not like I'm bragging about my recent platinum of Crisis Corey Reunion or anything... 😁
reviews.author: Klassy

reviews.title: A must have for ps5 owners
reviews.comment: Like literally every ps5 owner, I ran out of space on my ssd very quickly. Between the ssd being utilized for ps5 functionality as well as the large size of games, I ran out of the 1 tb space after like 4 or 5 games (I also have a portable hdd for all of my ps4 games). I was tired of deleting games in order to free up space, so I decided to add an additional 2 tb of storage. The install for the ssd was soooooooo simple! I checked out a YouTube video and had it installed in like 10 minutes or less. I don’t know much at all about the technical aspects of the ssd, but it runs fast and I haven’t had any issues with it whatsoever. I currently sent all my games for ps5 to the additional storage and still have plenty of room to go. I did my research on ps5 ssd and this one came highly recommended. Super easy install, additional space for games, and works great all for a pretty reasonable price!
